question: Does the native model correctly express both temporal will/had and present/past is/was choices at their two teacher-forced positions across every cell of a same-sequence 2x2 command factorial?

prior_art.known_lessons: Prior cross-task artifacts concatenate separate task rows and therefore do not establish simultaneous composition. Both task programs do share the final-residual decoder. Capability must be established before causal intervention and must score both command positions rather than one aggregate margin.
prior_art.novelty: Each row is one natural two-clause sequence with independently crossed temporal and is-was cues and correct auxiliaries. Teacher-forced native logits are scored at both auxiliary positions for all four 00/10/01/11 cells.

frozen_design.population: Sixteen lexical groups split 8 FIT/8 HOLDOUT and two fixed templates. Each row has four endpoints: future/present, past/present, future/past, and past/past, for 128 sequences total. No template or row is selected after outcomes.
frozen_design.outcomes: At the temporal auxiliary position score correct will versus had; at the later copular position score correct is versus was. Report margins and correctness separately for every phase/template/joint-cell/role.
frozen_design.gate: Every one of 32 phase x template x joint-cell x role cells must achieve at least 6/8 correct. FIT and HOLDOUT are both hard gates; aggregation cannot hide a failed command or composition cell.

predictions.pred_a_authority_positions_finiteness_an: Builder hashes, 32-row/128-sequence inventory, exact answer-token positions, finite logits/margins, model configuration, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_fit_every_joint_cell_and_role_is_: Every FIT template x joint-cell x temporal/iswas role cell has >=6/8 correct.
predictions.pred_c_holdout_every_joint_cell_and_role: Every HOLDOUT template x joint-cell x temporal/iswas role cell has >=6/8 correct.
predictions.pred_d_dual_command_license_is_issued: A/B/C all pass and all 32 rows are licensed without filtering.

decision: A/B/C/D licenses the exact 2x2 joint causal factorial after common-gauge basis capture. Any failed cell is an honest native capability null; do not filter rows or templates post hoc. This stage opens no causal outcome.
